notes.title: Wall World 2 Announcement
notes.notes:
The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall! 

[previewyoutube=CBwohPsHDl4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]New frontiers, greater dangers.[/b] The Wall is more alive than ever, and this time, it fights back from both within and without. New monster types lurk not only on the surface but deep inside the mines, turning every dig into a battle for survival. Adapt to the ever-changing biomes, overcome hazardous anomalies, and master new ways to traverse the Wall - whether by foot, spider leg, or something even more powerful. 

[b]Upgrade, customize, and conquer.[/b] Your robospider is more than just a machine - it’s your lifeline. Swap out legs for tank treads, enhance its firepower, and fine-tune your exosuit to match your playstyle. From devastating new weaponry to game-changing movement upgrades, Wall World 2 offers deeper progression, letting you build the ultimate digging war machine. 

[b]A living, breathing Wall. [/b]The mines stretch further than before, hiding lost technologies, mysterious artifacts, and uncharted wonders. Sphere City awaits as a hub for upgrades, interactions, and discoveries between expeditions. The deeper you dig, the more secrets you uncover - but be prepared, because some mysteries are better left undisturbed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/b21832806d2193dd722cf9fec24f69f313de55d0.gif[/img]
Wall World 2 builds upon everything that made the first game a thrilling rogue-lite adventure - expanding the world, more exciting combat, and adding more ways to explore, fight, and survive. The Wall is calling, Wall diggers. Will you answer? 

Add Wall World 2 to your wishlist to stay updated on the latest news, development progress, upcoming playtests, and the official release date: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/ 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/alawar][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/5cc1f7b669b340516b3fbb240d4844941704a3a8.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[b]Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 

[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch[/b] discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.notes:
The streets are filled with danger, and it’s time for you to step up and show your skills. Whether you’re ready to take on relentless thugs or master devastating combos, now’s your chance to join the fight! 

[previewyoutube=wK6XCqb_6Ko;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]How to Join the Playtest: [/b]

[olist]
[*] Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/]Karate Survivor[/url] Steam page.

Feel free to discuss, stream, and share your gameplay moments on our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3027950/discussions/]Steam forum[/url], or any social media platform. [b]About Karate Survivor:[/b] 
Step into the shoes of a martial arts master in this survival-like roguelite inspired by the adrenaline-pumping action movies of the ‘80s. Use the environment and improvised weapons to fight off waves of relentless enemies, master powerful combos, and survive the mean streets. With intense combat, dynamic progression, and fast-paced action, Karate Survivor promises a thrilling experience for all aspiring martial artists. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

Get ready to fight! The streets won’t clear themselves.

notes.title: Major Update 1.2 is here! Also, 6 new languages and OST
notes.notes:
Howdy, necromancers!

Firstly, thank you very much for your patience, for staying with us and for your support. We read all the feedback, your reviews are very inspiring 💙

Secondly, watching you play, we are quite impressed with how many skilled players there are among you. Some manage to hold out against enemies for more than an hour and even longer! However, the intended design and gameplay loop of our game does not provide for such long sessions – it’s simply not possible to save a game in the middle of a run.

We have repeatedly witnessed how players get tired of a long session and eventually just stop defending the tower in order to finish the game. Or said the game was too easy after several long runs with micro-controlling each unit, going to the main menu room only a couple of times, but buying a dozen upgrades at once. Or they said the game was too hard after a few long runs, but with no upgrades or control. In the end, it came down to the inability to predict the time of the game session – a problem that we wanted to address from the very beginning.

With Update 1.2, we are introducing a new system of timers, at the end of which your tower will be visited by powerful enemies. They’ll return you to the menu room, or they will be mercilessly destroyed by you – it is more than possible to defeat them (think of death in Vampire Survivors). It all depends on your upgrades and tactics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281409/462bfd18e4771b3c68622ad98203661f53c4bbb0.png[/img]

For the best gameplay experience, we recommend starting with a new profile. Don’t worry, all previous saves are not wiped and remain with you! The latest version of the game is 1.2.0.255 now.

[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new mechanics of spawners appearing from underground and a timer for such events
[*] Added 3 new achievements for destroying the aforementioned spawners
[*] Added French language support
[*] Added German language support
[*] Added Japanese language support
[*] Added Polish language support
[*] Added Korean language support
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese language support
[*] Reworked fonts to fix rare display issues
[*] Fixed the saw animation – before that it played 1 second longer than the damage was dealt
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281409/5bcd0c5bafef85a734f5bd17ba9e02db7d3a3773.gif[/img]

In addition, by player's demand, we're releasing the Necrosmith original soundtrack! It contains 5 tracks, so we set the lowest price that Steam gave us to choose. Get it only if you want to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099850/Necrosmith_Original_Soundtrack/
Looking forward to your reviews on this update 👉💀👈

notes.title: Big Brain Update 1.1 with major AI & control improvements is live
notes.notes:
We are happy to present THE long-awaited Necrosmith update (v1.1, codename Big Brain), bringing changes to the units AI (including enemies too), control over them, blueprint drops and converting body parts to mana! We've added the Brain Printer to the game, a machine that literally gives brains to your units. Now they can, for example, hold their position and maintain a social distance from the crowd of enemies. Available immediately for all players, so no need to purchase or upgrade this machine!

Make sure you have the latest (1.1.0.225) version of the game installed. The list of changes this time is bigger than usual, so we decided to break it into several blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281409/179d47a190cfa1b4e5f78a945c42837e124bbb00.png[/img]

[b]AI and control improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a command to hold position – it’s available in your unit window, click on the unit's icon at the bottom of the screen to access. You can also command your units to return to map exploring from there. Units holding their positions will be highlighted with a yellow circle.
[*] Now your units will try to keep their distance from enemies (depends on the type of their attacks – ranged or melee). No more ranged units charging at enemies and shouting "Leeroy Jenkins".
[*] Enemies are also smarter now – you can “piss them off” by making them chase your units until they slash them or realize that they’re not able to catch up.
[/list]
[b]QoL-improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now transform 10 body parts into mana at once using Shift+RMB combination.
[*] Added a tutorial for the “hold position” command – it will be shown to all new players and those who have not yet seen it in the game.
[/list]
[b]Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the drop of the upgraded blueprints.
[*] Increased spell damage on each level.
[*] Changed the movement speed of all enemy units.
[*] Changed the attack range of abilities, mainly for melee.
[*] Now it is much easier to activate the enemy spawners, be careful.
[*] Now the Morning Cocktail relic ability matches its description. Changed the body parts drop.
[*] Now all "bosses" will drop body parts – before that it worked only with 4 initial ones.
[*] Tons of other minor rebalances.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the "The Entire History of You" achievement (saving recipes).
[*] Fixed an issue with unit sprites getting stuck on the pentagram after creating.
[*] Fixed the visual appearance of the mantis ability.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=J5MOjj9bs8k;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for your patience! Let us know what you think about this update in the comments and Steam reviews 👉💀👈

notes.title: Playtest feedback and upcoming demo
notes.notes:
Hello future necromancers!

We want to once again thank everyone who took part in the Necrosmith playtest. Thank you for your interest in the game, for making videos, for posts in socials, and special thanks to the playtesters who shared their feedback after playing the game – you are the real MVPs! 💙

Here are some of the frequently requested improvements from the survey results that will definitely make it into the final version of the game:
[list]
[*] [b]Interface[/b]. You'll only need to double-click on the body part to put it in the slot you need. At the same time, the ability to drag-n-drop items is still there. If you want to put a body part in an already occupied slot, go for it – the body part from that slot will automatically return to your inventory.
[*] [b]Mana[/b]. Now you don't have to drag a creature fragment to the mana icon to transform it into a resource, you can easily do this by right-clicking on a body part right in your inventory. Thus, you can easily turn lotsa body parts into a resource to quickly get mana.
[*] [b]Portals[/b]. You now have full intuitive control over where your creature spawns. Situations in which you need a creature at the tower, but it appears in a portal somewhere else, are completely excluded. You decide where to spawn your undead unit.
[*] [b]Defense[/b]. For now we won't specify exactly how, but you will have the opportunity to make your creatures defend the tower if it is under attack, even if your undeads are busy exploring the map and capturing distant lands.
[/list]These are just a few improvements, a small part of what awaits you in the future during your conquests. We will add an alchemy machine, more body parts, new weapons and powerful spells to destroy all your enemies! [i]*evil necromancer laugh*[/i]

notes.title: Playtest Announcement
notes.notes:
A zombie, a harpy, and an orc met and went... to a Necrosmith playtest!

And you should join them! 👻

[b]The playtest will start on May 13[/b] (yes, Friday the 13th) on the game's Steam page, and will be available to all comers. Wishlist Necrosmith on Steam and follow our news to stay tuned.

Necrosmith is an indirect necromancer simulator where you need to assemble the dead using different body parts while upgrading your tower. Combine the abilities of the different fantastic races to fight your way through the hordes of enemies.

See you on Friday the 13th ☠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281409/07085aedd3f33270291532681a4c1a6fb67f3db9.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949190

notes.title: Undeads Assemble
notes.notes:
Get some zombie legs, mix them with orc arms, and attach a robot head to it… Your perfect dead man… ahem, we mean mighty warrior is ready! 👀

In Necrosmith you can assemble the dead by combining hundreds of different body parts that zombies, orcs, harpies and even robots have kindly (no) provided you with. These aren't just any body parts, of course, but body parts with unique parameters that affect your fighter's performance. Just don't tell the zombies (they're very sentimental) how many body parts you'll have to waste while searching for the perfect combination of survivability, speed, and combat power.  

You can also even give your dead a name. By the way, what will be the name for your pretty little dead man? 💀
